name: OpenCode Usage
author: alvmarrod
description: OpenCode usage and Go-limit widget for the Omarchy bar: per-provider tokens and cost, 7-day model breakdowns, and 5h/weekly/monthly Go allowances. OpenCode v2 support reads per-message usage and the active OAuth/API credential from opencode.db read-only. The credential is sent only to the official OpenCode Go usage endpoint and never printed or stored. Requires sqlite3, jq, and curl. Independent MIT continuation of Dahep/omarchy-plugin-opencode-usage and NiloyTheSpd/opencode-tracker.

barWidget.description: Per-provider token usage and Go limits.
